title: disposable deviled egg holders
text: disposable deviled egg holders. I resist disposable things, but in this case I needed something that was small and that I didn't need back (meaning it could not be retrieved) and so these are the perfect size and use.  It's not always possible to use things that are reusable - I try to do so 99% of the time.  In all honesty, if I could retrieve these, I would wash them by hand and reuse them a couple of times and I think the quality is such you could - key:  HANDWASH - NOT dishwasher safe.  You get a set of 6 -  6 tops and 6 bottoms.
